# Bear Grid

Bear Grid is a Netherlands-based independent R&D consultancy founded in 2019. It supports founders, companies, investors and institutions with technology assessment, R&D strategy, venture validation and innovation partnerships.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://beargridsolutions.com/
- Expertise: https://beargridsolutions.com/expertise
- Investors: https://beargridsolutions.com/investors
- Company history: https://beargridsolutions.com/history
- Contact: https://beargridsolutions.com/contact
- Original sensing-platform archive: https://beargridsolutions.com/history/original-platform

## Historical context

Bear Grid began as a deep-tech sensing startup in Israel in 2019 and has operated in the Netherlands since 2021. The preserved original-platform archive documents its seismic sensing, signal-classification and security-system work. Since 2024, Bear Grid has focused on independent R&D consultancy and venture support.
